name: round-2822-w3
title: Round #2822, wave 3: a restated fact becomes its own row (2-D, analytic, complex); 3-D answers keep t; «הנקודה M מקיימת»

cases.title: 2-D: restating a fact the triangle already holds adds it as its own row, with a notice
cases.lookFor: The last line is accepted as a third row of the givens, with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.» (new text). The triangle does not move.
cases.before: Prod records the row without saying it was already there.
cases.expectRefusal: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: 2-D: switch the first row off; the restated row keeps the relation
cases.lookFor: With «AB = AC» switched off, the triangle stays isosceles: the base angles at B and C are still equal, held by the row typed last.
cases.before: Unchanged in effect on prod (the row was recorded there too); this locks the reason the ruling keeps it as a row.
cases.expectRefusal: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: 2-D: a trapezoid's equal diagonals, restated, do not move the drawing
cases.lookFor: «AC = BD» is accepted with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.». The trapezoid looks the same before and after the line, in this view and in the next configuration.
cases.before: Prod moves the figure up to 2.9 units at the second configuration, with no notice.
cases.expectRefusal: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: 2-D: «D על BA» after «D על AB» does not move D
cases.lookFor: The last line is accepted with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.»; D stays where it was on AB.
cases.before: Prod reads the reversed letters as a second placement and moves D, at every configuration.
cases.expectRefusal: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: 2-D: a restatement that contradicts the figure is still refused
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused, naming the conflicting statement; the triangle keeps its 40° angle and there is no third row.
expectAbsent: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: Analytic: the same restatement is its own row, with the notice
cases.lookFor: The last line is accepted as a third row, with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.».
cases.before: Prod records the row without the notice.
expect: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: Complex: «|z1| = 5» after «z1 = 3+4i» is its own row, with the notice
cases.lookFor: The second line is accepted as its own row with the notice «זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.».
cases.before: Prod answers that it is already known, with no row.
expect: זה כבר קיים באיור — נוסף כנתון נפרד.

cases.title: 3-D (unchanged this wave): an exact repeat still answers «כבר קיים» without a row
cases.lookFor: The repeated «AB = AC» answers «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.», and no third row is added. In 3-D a restated line becoming its own row waits on your ruling on #2790.
expect: זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.

cases.title: 3-D: asking for a vector answers with the figure's letter t (PR #2826, you passed it)
cases.before: Prod cannot answer: the answer would need the letter t.

cases.title: 3-D: the exam's «הנקודה M מקיימת …» builds, and the membership question points at the panel (PR #2830, you passed it)
lines: נסמן: AA' = w, AB = v, AD = u
הנקודה E היא אמצע המקצוע BB'
האם הנקודה M נמצאת במישור AEC?
cases.lookFor: Every line builds; the last one adds nothing and says the answer is in the data panel's point × plane row.
cases.before: Prod does not read «הנקודה M מקיימת …» and has no point × plane row.
